preconditions.description: The number of nodes (n) and operations (m) are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct nodes within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in operations)
preconditions.description: Each operation pair (a_i, b_i) consists of distinct nodes within the valid range.
The input graph is a tree with exactly n-1 edges.

postconditions.expression: len(output) == n and all(0 <= c <= n - 1 for c in output)
postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers, each representing a valid count of common elements for each node.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= n and i != j and (output[i-1] == sum(1 for j in range(1, n+1) if i != j and (set(node_lists[i-1]) & set(node_lists[j-1])))) for i in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: For each node i, c_i is the count of nodes j (j ≠ i) such that the lists of node i and node j share at least one common number.
